caption:
In 2021, 99% of days on Earth were warmer than the hottest day of 1880.

Watch the whole bell curve of daily temperatures slide right: only 15% of days beat 1880's warmest in 1950, 77% by 1980 — and by 2021, 80% of days sit above +1 °C.

📊 See every day of the year sorted by temperature, from 1880 to 2021, in this animated distribution of global land-surface anomalies in 0.2 °C bins against the 1951-1980 average. Explore how warming moved the entire distribution, not just its average.

Source: Berkeley Earth, daily TAVG full dataset (CC BY-NC 4.0). 52,078 daily values; anomalies measured against the January 1951 – December 1980 average.
